title: Ritual of World Confluence
text: Requires one Advanced Ritual Energy Core, eight Crystal Pedestals, and one each of Earth, Water, Fire, Air, Light, Dark, Time and Space Microcores, in any order.

Once the offerings are ready, offer 10000 mB of Refined Spacetime using fluid containers, or an Output Upgrade with Spacetime Ports. Partial inputs are accepted; buckets are returned. The liquid forms a clockwise ring.

The completed ring is absorbed, consuming all eight Microcores and yielding one Genesis Particle. Removing an offering or breaking the ritual dissipates the ring without refunding liquid; remaining Microcores are retained. The core does not store fluid and rejects other liquids.
